_comment: Ready-to-apply branch ruleset for main. NOT applied automatically: GitHub rulesets on a PRIVATE repository require GitHub Pro/Team (verified against GitHub docs: 'Rulesets are available in public repositories with GitHub Free ... and in public and private repositories with GitHub Pro, GitHub Team, and GitHub Enterprise Cloud'). _how_to_apply_if_the_plan_changes: GitHub UI: Settings > Rules > Rulesets > New ruleset > Import a ruleset, paste this file.
API: POST https://api.github.com/repos/StevenMarketing/steven-ai-os/rulesets with this body (needs Administration: write, which this project deliberately does not grant the worker).
